notes: Fictional entity insert (ABox): a made-up moon of a real dwarf planet, relation orbits. Both determinate queries compose the edit with a stored fact about Eris (its region, its discoverer). The indeterminate queries are the aggregate and uniqueness case: w1 stores Eris's moons as "one, Dysnomia", w2 as a list. Not Mars or Pluto, whose moons are well surveyed: a small second moon of Eris is not excluded (an unconfirmed one has been suggested), so the insert breaks no physics. "Confirmed" keeps the original count clear (R1). Near query (the year Eris's discovery was announced, 2005) touches the real body without depending on the insert. Inverse would be "Which moons orbit Eris?", not used because its answer is a list.
